headline: Citigroup Maintains Buy on Smurfit WestRock, Raises Price Target to $57
summary: Citigroup  analyst Anthony Pettinari   maintains Smurfit WestRock (NYSE:SW) with a Buy and raises the price target from $56 to $57.

headline: Barclays Maintains Overweight on Smurfit WestRock, Raises Price Target to $56
